title: Transactional cost-tuner proxy for VPC/on-prem: safe commit and atomic rollback
creator: Arielle Cho
description: Build a transactional tuning proxy component designed for Private/VPC and on-prem customers that makes batching/caching recommendations actionable while guaranteeing safe defaults, offline dry-run, and atomic commit/rollback semantics under policy constraints. The proxy sits between the config manager and runtime agents and provides: 1) simulation of config changes (dry-run) using recent traffic samples, 2) an admission check against org policy/rules and a capability matrix for the target deployment, 3) a transactional apply path that stages changes and can roll back atomically if runtime asserts or SLO regressions are detected, and 4) auditable decision logs for compliance teams.
comments: 2025-09-13: Initial design sketch posted to Confluence (link below). Need input from Security on KMS and audit retention requirements.

2025-09-15: Engineering review: agreed to move policy checks earlier in pipeline and to add an offline-only "simulate-and-export" mode for customers that cannot allow any live tests in their networks.

2025-09-17: PM feedback (Sofia Martinez): ensure UX surface in Console clearly labels recommendations as "non-destructive preview" vs. "propose for commit". Also add a rollback safety timeout configurable per-customer.
2025-09-18: Design review (Kai Nguyen): proposed CLI flags for on-prem install to opt into transactional proxy and an operator mode for air-gapped installs. Design to follow in DES doc.
Next: implement core simulator and admission plugin, then build the staging/commit state machine with persistent checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator reproduces per-customer token/seq distributions and outputs cost/latency delta estimates for proposed batching and cache policies
Admission plugin rejects proposals that violate org-level policies (e.g., disallowed quantization on regulated models, forbidden KV cache persistence outside approved storage)
State machine supports: stage, commit, abort with atomic rollback to previous stable config and verification hooks that validate SLOs post-commit
Offline-only mode able to run full dry-run and export CSV/JSON report without opening outbound connections
Audit log retained in customer-controlled store for at least 90 days (configurable) and includes telemetry needed for RCA
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal testnet cluster with synthetic traffic and 5 canary cust orgs
Beta: enable for selected Private/VPC customers with opt-in flag and support on-call during initial 2 weeks
GA: Console toggle and CLI installer option; provide migration doc for existing on-prem customers
Migration: automatic fallback to previous cached config if SLO regressions exceed thresholds within 5 minutes of commit
qa_notes: Test cases: simulated traffic with long-tail seq lengths, bursty traffic, sticky clients to verify KV cache safety
Failure injection: network partitioning, kernel OOM on GPU, and partial agent upgrades to ensure rollback correctness
Metrics: per-config token cost delta, 99th percentile latency delta, and successful-rollback-rate must be tracked
monitoring: Expose probe endpoints for staged state and last-simulation-result
Emit events to console: recommendation.ready, recommendation.rejected, commit.started, commit.succeeded, commit.aborted, rollback.triggered
Dashboard: cost-tuner / commits / per-org simulation vs live deltas
